reviews.author: Dalcomidorossi
reviews.text:
When strawberries are the most delicious season, like these days, there is a menu you naturally crave. It's strawberry shaved ice. However, when you actually order it, it's mostly ice and there are quite a few cases where there are a few pieces of strawberry on top. That's why there are many people looking for the right strawberry shaved ice. The place I visited this time is Cafe Occam, which has become famous as a seasonal shaved ice restaurant in Konkuk University. I tried pure milk strawberry shaved ice with plenty of fresh strawberries and a rich black Americano.

Cafe Occam is a cafe known for its shaved ice near the entrance to Konkuk University. The exterior has a calm and clean feel, and the interior is centered around warm lighting and wood-toned interior. The spacing between seats is appropriate, creating a comfortable atmosphere for conversation.

I visited for shaved ice, but the cafe itself had a good atmosphere, making me want to visit again. It is a perfect space to visit alone and enjoy dessert time with friends.

The most impressive part is the amount of strawberries. True to its name, Pure Milk Strawberry Shaved Ice, it is served with a generous amount of fresh strawberries. Rather than thinly sliced ​​strawberries, it is filled with large slices of seasonal strawberries, so satisfaction is high from the first sight.

The sour taste of seasonal strawberries is clearly felt, and it is not overly sweet. It does not feel like it is flavored with syrup, but rather retains the natural acidity and sweetness of strawberries. If you like strawberries, this is a composition that will satisfy you.

The basis of shaved ice is ice. The pure milk strawberry shaved ice here uses milk-based ice rather than water ice. The texture is soft and melts when you put it in your mouth, and doesn't melt like water.

What's particularly impressive is that the flavor remains balanced until the end. Some shaved ice tends to be sweet on top and bland on the bottom, but this one maintains the sweet, savory taste of milk. The acidity of strawberries and the savory flavor of milk combine naturally.

The black Americano I ordered with shaved ice was also well balanced. It is a style that does not have too much acidity and has a heavy body. It appears to be a roast suitable for drinking with sweet desserts.

A spoonful of strawberry shaved ice followed by a sip of Americano will cleanse your mouth. It has a structure that leaves no trace of sweetness and makes you want to eat the next spoonful. It is a combination that goes well with dessert and coffee.

It's disappointing if the amount of shaved ice is small, and even if there is a lot, if the taste is monotonous, you get tired of it quickly. Cafe Occam's Pure Milk Strawberry Shaved Ice has the right amount of strawberries and milk ice, making it perfect for two people to share.

Considering that enough fresh strawberries were used, the satisfaction level is high compared to the composition. Due to the nature of the menu using seasonal fruits, you can experience the best taste if you visit during the season.

If you are looking for strawberry shaved ice, there are two most important criteria. The freshness of the strawberries and the perfection of the ice. Café Ockham ticks both boxes.

You can truly feel the sourness of fresh strawberries, and the pure milk ice maintains the savory taste until the end. Adding black Americano here completes the balance of taste. If you are looking for a shaved ice restaurant in Konkuk University, this is an option worth visiting at least once.

The pure milk strawberry shaved ice that I tried at Café Okam, a shaved ice restaurant in Konkuk University, was a menu item that was made with plenty of fresh strawberries, allowing you to fully enjoy the sourness of seasonal strawberries. The milk-based ice maintained its sweet and savory taste until the end, making it a good combination with strawberries. The Black Americano we ordered together has a deep flavor that balances out the sweetness of the shaved ice and provides overall balance. If you want to truly enjoy strawberry shaved ice, visiting during the seasonal season is a good option.

It is not easy to express the taste of coffee. I often find it difficult to know how to express subtle flavors, even with my limited vocabulary. I would like to distinguish between the bitter taste caused by roasting and the taste resulting from differences in the coffee beans, but there is still insufficient data. Therefore, even today, I can only describe the taste of the coffee I tasted today as a heavy coffee taste with an astringent (possibly bitter) flavor as the base.

Those who like fluffy soufflés, pay attention here!

This is a newly opened soufflé specialty cafe near Konkuk University Station, and as soon as I took a bite, I fell in love with the texture that melted in my mouth.

The chocolate cream soufflé (15,000 won) I had was a thick soufflé topped with rich chocolate milk cream and ice cream, so it was perfect for filling up my sugar intake.

Perhaps because it was made immediately after ordering, the texture and softness were superb!

The cafe latte I drank with it was also savory and went well with the soufflé.

Above all, the space is spacious as the entire building is used from the 2nd to the 4th floor rooftop, and the European-style wood-tone interior is very pretty for taking pictures.

Dogs are allowed on the 3rd and 4th floors, so next time I plan to go on a rooftop outing with my dog!

If you are looking for a date course or dessert cafe with a nice atmosphere in Konkuk University, be sure to stop by.
